_readme: Four live cards from part 1's list (tests/fixtures/operator-agent-board-2026-11-01.json, read 2026-11-01), for tests/test_operator_do_close.py (DRE-8925). Each keeps only its identifier, lane, title, labels and at most three short sentences quoted from its description. DRE-7328 names the console's Record the outcome in its own title. DRE-8637 and DRE-7978 name no close of their own, so the test adds one sentence to each, word for word as tests/test_operator_do_ops.py adds it: `card-done` to DRE-8637, the merge of its own pull request to DRE-7978. DRE-8623 names no close and is left so. The card-done case on a card without `no-code` is DRE-8637 with that one label taken off in the test.

cards.title: OPERATOR: set NO_RECORD_RETURN_MODE=enforce on the live relay, then close this card through the console's Record the outcome
quotes: Turn the relay's no-record return on, live.

cards.title: bureau-pipeline: turn on the Alarm Repair — set the repository variable ALARM_REPAIR_LIVE to true
quotes: In bureau-pipeline's repository settings, under Actions variables, set `ALARM_REPAIR_LIVE` to `true`, in the operator's name.

cards.title: bureau-pipeline: the operator opens one throwaway pull request that breaks the verify step, sees the replay gate hold it, and closes it unmerged
quotes: The negative control for the replay gate: the operator makes one change that breaks the verify step, watches the gate hold it, and closes it.

cards.title: bureau-pipeline: delete the PLANNER_MAX_RUNNING repo variable from agent-bureau, bureau-pipeline, portico and agent-bureau-demo, and release any card the groom queue left in Intake (operator)
quotes: Deleting a repo variable needs a person holding admin on each repo, so the operator deletes it, one repo at a time, once nothing that is running reads or writes it any more.
